question: Which of the following is not a Cabinet Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Committee on Conflicts among Ministers**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Appointment Committee of the Cabinet**, **Committee on Political Affairs**, and **Committee on Investment and Growth** are well-known Cabinet Committees.
 
• However, there is no such committee named the **Committee on Conflicts among Ministers**.
